children: Copper falls in early Asian trade, with its three-month LME contract 0.3% lower at $13,797.50 a ton. Weakness in technology stocks has weighed on sentiment in the copper market, ANZ Research writes in a note. Investors are concerned that demand may be negatively impacted by any slowdown in the data center buildout, ANZ says. However, there continue to be signs of tightness in the physical market in China given output cuts at Chinese smelters due to weak margins, ANZ adds. (kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
